units.title: SG-5.1 · One owner for round types, admin routes agree with them
Act: Add round.Service adapter for admin.RoundService
Act: Mount admin round routes and expose the scheduler
units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Wired the round routes and scheduler; `go build ./cmd/server` and `go vet` pass, and every package passes except `TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted`. That test fails on 3 subtests (open, close, GET /rounds/{id}) with 404 "Not Found" because the test treats any 404 as unmounted. The 404 comes from the handler (admin.fail, body "Not Found\n") for a round that doesn't exist in the empty temp repo, so the routes are mounted. Verify should fix the expectation or fixture; I did not edit tests. Changes: (1) server.go: admin round routes under the admin group, newRoundService(cfg) helper, NewScheduler(cfg); (2) step 1 adapted: an existing roundAdmin in internal/server/rounds_adapter.go (UNIT-083, commit 2c31909) is used instead of a new adapter, and it does not apply config defaults, so I wrapped it in roundDefaults in server.go to fill Duration and BaseRelease, since round.Service.Create rejects a zero duration; (3) step 2 adapted: the Contributions lister is a fresh contribution.FileStore; (4) step 3 adapted: main uses an http.Server that shuts down on the signal context, because signal.NotifyContext swallows Ctrl-C and would otherwise stop the process from exiting. Open risk: New and NewScheduler create separate round.Service instances, so their mutexes don't cover each other, and an admin Open can race a scheduler tick on the same round files and git commits. Fixing that needs one shared service, which the step's signatures don't allow. Also, the git index changed during the run (rounds_adapter.go and rounds_adapter_test.go are staged as deleted and untracked, main.go and server.go are partly staged); I did not touch the index or commit.

units.title: Verify: Admin round route wiring unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken
tests.title: Admin round endpoints reject requests without a token and accept Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok and a temp repo_path, when each admin round endpoint is called without Authorization it responds 401, and with Bearer tok it does not respond 401
tests.detail: 5 endpoints x 2 cases = 10 subtests, all PASS

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted
tests.title: Admin round routes are mounted under /api/v1/admin
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok and a temp repo holding world the-boys-room and round-0000001, when each admin round endpoint is called with Bearer tok it does not respond 404
tests.detail: 5 subtests PASS after the fixture was corrected to the round.FileStore layout (worlds/<world>/rounds/<id>/round.yaml). Open/close log a git 'not a git repository' error from the temp dir and return 500, which is not 404.

tests.name: TestNewScheduler_UsesConfig
tests.title: NewScheduler uses the configured scheduler interval and wires the controller and round store
tests.scenario: Given a config with round.scheduler_interval 7s and a temp storage.repo_path, when NewScheduler is built, then Interval is 7s and Controller and Rounds are non-nil
tests.detail: Newly added in backend/internal/server/server_test.go after TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted
